title.narrative: Y(our) - SPACE: Youth Space for Learning, Engagement and Participation

description.narrative: The overall objective of the Action is to contribute to the empowerment and increasing of the voice of youth and young adults in Belarusian society and to strengthening of the initiatives of the Belarusian diaspora in Ukraine and in neighbouring countries. Specific objectives of the action are a) The needs of target groups are identified and an adequate intervention is developed accordingly; b) Active members of Belarusian diaspora including relocated CSOs and youth benefit from the Hub and use it for their own initiatives; c) Belarusian youth use Online Camps and Networking for learning, personal development and economic engagement.
